transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

Yeah, um… I guess I’m here because things at work have gotten kind of uncomfortable. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic or anything, but ever since I got that county safety award, some people have been… I don’t know, twisting my inspection reports around, asking these pointed budget questions like they’re trying to make me look dishonest.

My supervisor says it’s just normal review, and maybe that’s how it looks on paper, but I can tell there’s more to it. It feels coordinated, like certain people are trying to discredit me. Does that make sense?
Can you tell me more about how you know these people are specifically targeting you or trying to discredit you? Have you noticed any specific actions or evidence that supports this belief?

I mean, I don’t have, like, a smoking gun or anything, if that’s what you mean. I’m not trying to sound paranoid. It’s more the pattern.

Since I got that county safety award, certain people started going through my inspection reports differently—like pulling out little things and making them seem suspicious, or asking these budget questions in a way that feels pointed. Like they’re trying to imply I’m doing something crooked, even though I’m just doing my job.

My supervisor keeps saying it’s normal review, and I get that maybe it could look that way. But it feels too coordinated to be random. I can tell they’re trying to make me look bad. That probably sounds like a lot, but… that’s honestly what it feels like.
Have you had thoughts that people at work were trying to harm or undermine you even before you received the county safety award?

Not really before that, no. I mean, work had normal disagreements like anywhere, but I didn’t feel like people were… watching for ways to trip me up or anything.

It’s been more like the past year, since I got recognized for that county safety initiative. That’s when I started noticing the shift. I’m not trying to make it sound bigger than it is, but that’s the timeline as best as I can tell.
Have you noticed any other changes in your mood, sleep, or thoughts besides feeling like you’re being targeted at work?

Um… I don’t think so, not anything major. I mean, I get stressed about it, obviously, and I probably think about work more than I should, but I wouldn’t say my mood or sleep has changed in some big way.

I’m still getting through my days and going to work. It’s mostly just this situation there that’s been bothering me. Does that answer what you mean?

When you say people at work are trying to discredit you, do you feel this is happening because of something you know they believe about you, or do you sometimes think they’re acting on information you aren’t aware of?

I guess… I don’t know for sure what they believe about me, exactly. I don’t want to make it sound like I can read their minds or anything.

It’s more that ever since I got that county safety award, certain people started treating my work differently. Like they’ll twist something in my inspection reports, or ask budget questions in this pointed way, like they’re trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor says it’s just normal review, and I hear that, but it really doesn’t feel normal to me. It feels coordinated, like there’s something going on behind the scenes that I’m not fully being told.

I know that probably sounds bad, but that’s the best way I can explain it.
Have you ever felt that people outside of work, or in other parts of your life, have been acting against you or trying to harm you in some way?

No, not really outside of work. I mean, I don’t walk around thinking everyone’s out to get me or anything like that.

It’s mainly this work situation. Ever since that county safety award, certain people there have been twisting my inspection reports, asking these pointed budget questions, like they’re trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor keeps saying it’s normal review, and I’m trying to be fair about that, but… it doesn’t feel that way to me. It feels coordinated, like an effort to discredit me.

But outside of work, no, I haven’t really noticed that. Does that make sense?
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that other people were acting against you, even when there wasn’t clear evidence, or that others could read your mind or were sending you secret messages?

I mean… not the mind-reading or secret messages part. I don’t think anything like that.

The acting against me part, though… I guess that’s why I’m here. Ever since I got that county safety award, certain people at work have been twisting my inspection reports and asking these really pointed budget questions, like they’re trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor says it’s just normal review, and I’m trying to be reasonable about that, but it really feels coordinated to me, like they’re trying to discredit me.

I know that may sound like I’m reading into it, but that’s honestly how it comes across.
Have you ever had beliefs or suspicions that turned out to be completely untrue, even though you were very sure they were real at the time?

I mean… I try to be careful about that. I don’t want to say I’ve never been wrong about anything, because everybody can misread a situation.

But with this work thing, I still don’t think I’m just making it up. Ever since that county safety award, certain people have been twisting my inspection reports and asking these pointed budget questions, like they’re trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor keeps saying it’s just normal review, and I’m trying to take that in, honestly, but I can tell there’s something coordinated about it… like an effort to discredit me.

I know that maybe doesn’t answer exactly how you asked it, but that’s the one situation that comes to mind.

Even though your supervisor has told you that the reviews are normal, do you still feel certain that the actions against you are part of a coordinated effort to discredit you, and do you find it hard to accept any other explanation?

I mean… “certain” is a strong word, and I don’t want to sound like I’m refusing to listen. I know my supervisor keeps saying it’s just normal review, and I’m trying to take that seriously.

But yes, I still feel like there’s more to it. Ever since that county safety award, certain people at work have been twisting my inspection reports and asking these pointed budget questions, like they’re trying to make me look crooked. It doesn’t feel random to me. It feels coordinated, like they’re trying to discredit me.

I can hear other explanations, I just… have a hard time believing them, if I’m being honest. Does that sound reasonable?
Even though there's no clear evidence and your supervisor has said it's just a normal review, do you still believe, deep down, that this coordinated effort to discredit you is definitely real?

I… yeah, deep down I do think it’s real. I know that probably sounds like I’m being stubborn, and I’m not trying to ignore what my supervisor said.

But ever since that county safety award, the way certain people have been twisting my inspection reports and asking those pointed budget questions… it feels like they’re trying to make me look crooked. I don’t have some perfect proof I can hand you, but I can tell there’s something coordinated going on to discredit me.

I’m trying to be fair about it, honestly. But yes, I still believe that.
